_coverage.mcx_option_minutes: lake options_rolling_1m MCX books start 5 Aug 2025 17:45 IST and end 19 Oct 2026 23:29: NGEVE, SILM and USSIL (whose engines read the future from these files' `spot`) cannot be rebuilt before 5 Aug 2025; 1 Dec 2022 - 4 Aug 2025 has no trades for them (not invented)
_coverage.mcx_daily_futures: lake fut_daily_continuous MCX: 2 Jan 2012 - 16 Oct 2026 (TREND rebuilt over all of it; its first trade is 1 Nov 2012, the first month-end with 252 days of history); no LEAD
_coverage.mcx_futures_minutes_with_volume_oi: lake fut_1m_mcx_continuous holds the near month only from NATURALGAS 26 Aug 2026, SILVERM 27 Feb 2026 (patchy: near_share >= 0.5 on 47 of 255 days), SILVER 30 Jun, CRUDEOIL 18 Sep 2026; f_vol_rel, f_oi_chg, f_od, f_oiq, f_rng_proxy are NaN elsewhere
_coverage.us_hourly: Yahoo 1-hour SI=F, NG=F, CL=F, GC=F from 10 Jun 2024, INR=X from 15 Jan 2024, to 30 Oct 2026 (fetched 1 Nov 2026 as R2's fetch_yahoo.sh); f_us_on / f_fx_on NaN before. Yahoo's front-month series jump at its own contract rolls (NG=F most), which shows in f_us_on on those days
_coverage.us_data_calendar: R2 events.py CPI / NFP, fomc.py FOMC, lake xauusd_1m/us_events.csv: Jun 2024 - Oct 2026; f_us_data NaN outside
_coverage.features_note: signed with the trade: f_push, f_trend20, f_gap, f_d_open, f_ret5, f_us_on, f_od, f_oiq (direction); unsigned: f_d_pdh, f_d_pdl, f_fx_on (USD/INR log move, as asked), ranges, volumes. ATR = mean daily high-low of the last 14 sessions (lake daily). f_dte / f_roll_days count MCX trading days on the data's day list (weekdays after its end) to the option series' expiry / the first day of the next series (public calendar dates, inferred by each engine from the data); TREND: f_dte NaN (no expiry in M2's data), f_roll_days to M2's next detected roll. Price features use each engine's own price series (the options' `spot` future for NGEVE / SILM / USSIL, M2's Dhan daily for TREND).

NGEVE.engine: research/hunt/m3 (m3lib imported; run_book, costs copied verbatim)
NGEVE.recost_note: net uses M3's own spread for these trades (0.29% after 17:00); M3's 9 Oct re-cost with the measured 0.43% gave +Rs 70/trade on the holdout instead of +Rs 93

SILM.engine: research/hunt/m4 build.py + analyze.py (R42's path-only patch, R42_ONLY=1: the frozen cell's candidates only)

holdout_to_7oct.why_different: strike: M4's unstable sort picked OTM3 where OTM2 also had a price (here OTM2, the app's rule; 3 trades); exit price (3 trades): where one source has no print in the exit minute M4 prices it by B76 at the day's filled IV, so the lake's fuller minutes give a real print or a different fallback

TREND.engine: research/hunt/m2 prep.build + engine (load, signal TSM252, run_futures, stats) imported unchanged
TREND.legs_missing_why: LEAD (LEADMINI leg): not in the lake's daily futures; the Dhan token was expired on 1 Nov so it could not be refetched. The rebuild runs on the other 6 legs.

published.note: MCX_TREND.md walk-forward pick 'PORT 12-month TSM L/S', to 7 Oct 2026

TREND.roll_flag_note: M2's prep.roll_days keeps the largest OI jump within 15 days, so a roll flag can move a few days with later data; the trades follow the engine's flags as they are on the full data
TREND.open_trades_note: 6 trades still open at the data's last daily close are marked to it (exit_why open_at_data_end_mtm)
TREND.trade_list_rules: 1 lot of each mini (GOLDPETAL 1 lot as the app, the research held 5), every month-end signal taken, no Rs 1 lakh margin / ruin rule (the app's arm has none); M2's own costs (Zerodha + half spread + 0.02% slippage a side) and roll round trips
